conventions.convention: Use metric diag(-1,1,1,1), epsilon_12=1 and natural units ℏ=c=1. At rest P^μ=(M,0,0,0), M>0, so P_0=-M; the mixed supercharge anticommutator is 2M times the spinor and flavor Kronecker deltas.
For N=2, Z^{12}=zI and Z^{21}=-zI. Set ω=z/|z| when z≠0 and ω=1 otherwise. Define A=Q^1_1−ω(Q^2_2)* and A♯=(Q^1_1)*−conjugate(ω)Q^2_2.

Charge adjoints are actual Hilbert adjoints; all calculations take place on a common dense invariant product domain. A♯ denotes the displayed combination of individual adjoints, without identifying it with the maximal-domain adjoint of an unbounded sum. The inner product is linear in its first variable.

A BPS-saturated state is a nonzero common-domain vector in a specified massive rest fiber satisfying M=‖Z‖op. This records algebraic saturation and establishes neither physical realization nor dynamical stability. Countable Choice is an explicit inherited assumption.

load_bearing.statement: Under the stated Countable Choice, positive massive N=2 rest-fiber and common invariant product-domain hypotheses, for every ψ∈D, ⟨(AA♯+A♯A)ψ,ψ⟩=‖Aψ‖²+‖A♯ψ‖²=4(M−|z|)‖ψ‖². Consequently, for every nonzero ψ∈D, M=|z| if and only if Aψ=A♯ψ=0.

A BPS-saturated state in this item is a nonzero vector ψ∈D in a specified massive rest fiber for which M=‖Z‖op. For N=2, ‖Z‖op=|z|, and a nonzero domain vector saturates the bound if and only if both displayed supercharge combinations annihilate it.
